verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions (gitea-docs-2, gitea-docs-15) provides GitHub Actions-compatible CI/CD that runs via self-hosted act_runner instances, and community users report running CI alongside Gitea via self-hosted pipelines (gitea-comm-8, gitea-comm-14). However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents runner registration, labels, or private-runner configuration steps. Missing for 10: explicit runner registration/config docs, evidence of scaling multiple runners, independent hands-on confirmation of Gitea Actions runner setup (vs external CI like Drone).
